uses.quote: GenAI must not be used to promote discrimination, bias, or harm.

decided_by.quote: TU Dublin recommends the use of the Artificial Intelligence Assessment Scale in the design of assessments and for communication with students about assessments.
To support academic integrity, GenAI can only be used by students in ways that are approved in advance by their lecturer.
Students are then informed of this in their assessment brief.

duty.quote: Recording the use of GenAI in an assessment will be in accordance with assessment guidelines and disciplinary conventions, which may require addition of details of how the system was used, in text citations or a combination of both.

contents.quote: which may require addition of details of how the system was used, in text citations or a combination of both.
The details of how GenAI has been used in an assessment should be presented in line with the assessment guidelines, e.g. citations, supply of prompts used

referencing.quote: The approved use of artificial intelligence systems and/or generative models are transparent and they are appropriately cited as set out in library guidelines.

exempt.quote: This includes the use of any system that amends text beyond simple spelling and grammar checks.
AI can be used throughout the assessment and the student is not required to specify which content is AI generated.
